installation: local Git candidate; tagged release continuation checked separately
method: Real Codex exec against Magpie native route; nine sequential file reads, automatic compaction, then node --test and exact recall. Isolated fixture with twelve random associations; oracle not read by model. User authorized full-access execution scoped to fixture after read-only sandbox refused its first read.
limitations: Initial browser verification required interactive recovery; a new upstream challenge is still possible.

This live run initially encountered model-picker timeouts (one failed gateway record with seven attempts, followed by a successful record with three attempts). Subsequent tool rounds and compaction succeeded without extra gateway attempts.

Codex truncated each large tool output to about 40K characters before storing it. This is evidence for automatic compaction and continuation with the actual retained tool results, not full-file or expanded-window retention.
Twelve associations were specified for retention. This single sample does not establish lossless summarization or 1M capacity.
Physical Windows reboot was not performed.
